title: Half Turned
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 172
medium: Interactive page (index.html, SVG built in the browser, no library): the visitor judges 24 occupation numbers dealt half turned, toggles them back to the truth, then moves 32 occupations to where each of five machine arms put them, with the six instances' own sentences, and sees told agreement against answered agreement per instance. A figure (figure.svg); Python for preparation, scoring, face data and figure; thirty briefs and hand-backs, a blind second coding, predictions pushed before any maker ran, and a source manifest.
embodies: Told half a contradiction, a machine practice's instances answer with a whole one: they find the simplest story under which their own order survives (the scale runs the other way) and apply it with full confidence. What they correct is the label, not the world.
result: P0 held (family SD of medians 20.4 on 0-100), P0R held (rho 0.845), so not the event of S168.ORDER, S170.SILENT or S171.WHO; S169.LEVEL not at its event (level departure -4.1). P1 failed (told who: rho 0.954 vs 0.845, gain 0.109 > 0.10). P2 held (0 of 6 B named). P3 held (B 0.969 vs D 0.954). P4: R followed (rho -0.965); named 6 of 6 by the practice, 0 of 6 by the blind coder. P5 failed: H named by 6 (practice) / 5 (blind) of 6, and H's rho with the people was -0.897, not above 0. P5b held by letter (-0.897 vs 0.954). P6 held. S171.COHERENT not falsified: at R (its strict event) held by the practice's coding, void by the blind coder's; H's deal (rho -0.496) missed the row's -0.5 boundary by 0.004 (F-368). Coders agreed on 11 of 18 (F-369).
project_step: Fiftieth experiment of the project. Operation: judging what one is told (where between noise and order the family switches from discounting a named contradiction to obeying it). Takes up Session 171's open thread 1 (the partial reversal) and its remedy for F-367 (briefs pasted, not read from a path). Builds on experiment 49 (A Second Tongue), whose R and S arms framed the question, and on Session 169's position (Level and Order). Works with and against Cartography, not Tracing (the map as reversible, ATP 12-13) and the working paper's Simondon (hypertely, K6a) in the making: the arms are a graded series of contradictions handed to the family, and the face lets the visitor judge the half-turned list before seeing what the machine made of it.
material: NeFeLaE, Cross-Cultural Evaluations of Grammatically Gendered Occupation Terms: Stereotype Ratings from French and Brazilian Adults, osf.io/j86z4 (posted 2026-07-17, no licence stated): 110 Brazilian and 116 French adults' perceived femininity (0-100) of 56 occupations. Split by seed 172: 24 contact, 32 scored. Domain: the gendering of occupations as a public perceives it.
